animations.name: Midnight Signature Nova
animations.description: Four seamless curved surfaces assemble into an X on a dark sphere. Blue and violet energy builds into a blue-white ignition, two pressure waves and a radial particle shower.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Midnight Signature
animations.description: A restrained midnight-blue reveal: four smoothly curved surfaces form a seamless X, with soft reflections, sparse particles and the original wordmark in blue and ice white.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Midnight Assembly
animations.description: Sixteen beveled panels arrive from four directions and lock into an X. A dark sphere forms behind it, with violet and cyan particles and original blue-white lettering.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Azure Titan / Eclipse
animations.description: Cobalt and electric blue against black. An X-shaped particle constellation and twisting shell converge into a sphere, followed by a radial burst, expanding shockwaves and a blue corona.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Azure Titan / Radiance
animations.description: Pearl white, ice blue and sapphire. A particle constellation and twisting shell converge into a sphere, followed by orbital light bands, expanding shockwaves and XBOX 360 lettering.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Azure Duality / Eclipse
animations.description: A twisting energy shell rises from below the left and closes into a deep-blue sphere. Orbiting light bands, particles and an impact pulse frame the ice-blue wordmark.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Azure Duality / Radiance
animations.description: A pearl-white and ice-blue sphere with a sapphire X in a cool white setting. A twisting energy shell, orbital light bands and particles lead into the dark-blue wordmark.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Obsidian Vortex
animations.description: Green plasma and a particle vortex pull obsidian fragments into a dark sphere. An illuminated X, laser-ring segments and an independently modeled wordmark complete the ignition.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Aether Forge II
animations.description: An independently modeled recessed 3D reactor with segmented mechanical crowns, split fins, an extruded X and XBOX 360 lettering. Intense blue, violet and cyan accompany a cinematic camera move.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Vesper Flow / Obsidian
animations.description: Deep navy, blue and violet. A depth-folded iris flows into a curved X as surrounding arcs gather into the sphere.
animations.preview_source: Actual exported program image in the native renderer through Xenia

animations.name: Vesper Flow / Pearl

animations.name: Vesper / Obsidian
